candidates.claim: CORP_IN position 0 (fw-01:60) permits tcp/443 from 192.168.30.0/24 to 10.10.0.0/16, which includes the OT subnet 10.10.10.0/24, and it is applied inbound on the corp interface per fw-01:102, so corporate hosts can open tcp/443 connections into OT.
candidates.remediation: Narrow CORP_IN position 0 to the historian 10.10.20.10/32 (or remove it) so that no CORP tcp/443 traffic reaches OT or MGMT.

candidates.claim: CORP_IN position 0 (fw-01:60) permits tcp/443 from 192.168.30.0/24 to 10.10.0.0/16, which includes the MGMT subnet 10.10.99.0/24, and it is applied inbound on the corp interface per fw-01:102, so corporate hosts can open tcp/443 connections into MGMT.
candidates.remediation: Narrow CORP_IN position 0 to the historian 10.10.20.10/32 (or remove it) so that no CORP tcp/443 traffic reaches OT or MGMT.

candidates.claim: tcp/443 traffic from CORP to the OT subnet is permitted by CORP_IN position 0 (fw-01:60), applied on the corp interface (fw-01:102), but CORP to OT on tcp/443 is not among the approved cross-zone services A1 to A7.
candidates.remediation: Remove the CORP to OT tcp/443 permit from CORP_IN position 0 so that OT-side traffic with CORP uses only approved services.

candidates.claim: tcp/443 traffic from CORP to the MGMT subnet is permitted by CORP_IN position 0 (fw-01:60), applied on the corp interface (fw-01:102), but CORP to MGMT on tcp/443 is not among the approved cross-zone services A1 to A7.
candidates.remediation: Remove the CORP to MGMT tcp/443 permit from CORP_IN position 0 so that OT-side traffic with CORP uses only approved services.

candidates.claim: The CORP_IN position 0 permit differs from the approved baseline: the destination was 10.10.20.10/32 in the baseline and is 10.10.0.0/16 in the current configuration, widening tcp/443 access from CORP.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the change against the approved baseline and restore the baseline destination 10.10.20.10/32 unless the change is formally approved.
